title: The four-piece combo at the Ritz and pianist Frank Panera
summary: A small combo at Jimmy Moran's Ritz with Pinky Gerbrek and Monk Hazel; they try to recall the pianist, eventually Frank Panera.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
